description: This file defines the EngineeringValidations class which provides static methods for validating numeric values (float and int) in engineering calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: EngineeringValidations
classes.description: Provides static methods to validate and convert values to float and int types for engineering calculations.

methods.name: validateFloat
methods.description: Validates that the input is numeric and returns it as a float; throws an exception otherwise.

methods.name: validateInt
methods.description: Validates that the input is numeric and returns it as an integer (floor value); throws an exception otherwise.
